# PromptBill

> Semantic LLM Leaderboard, Individual Model Pages (/models/[slug]), Head-to-Head Comparisons (/compare/[a]-vs-[b]), Provider Hubs & Cost Calculators for https://promptbill.online.

## Core Pages
- [Leaderboard](https://promptbill.online/): Semantic LLM leaderboard and cost intelligence workspace.
- [All Models](https://promptbill.online/models): Directory of tracked models, pricing, context windows, and throughput.
- [Compare Models](https://promptbill.online/compare): Head-to-head LLM comparisons.
- [API Pricing](https://promptbill.online/pricing): Input, output, and reasoning API pricing reference.
- [LLM Selector](https://promptbill.online/tools/llm-selector): Interactive tool to pick an LLM by workload.
- [Token Counter](https://promptbill.online/tools/token-counter): Live prompt token estimator.
- [Routing Simulator](https://promptbill.online/tools/routing-simulator): Hybrid economy-to-flagship routing cost simulator.
